question.text: 27 drops of mercury coalesce to form a bigger drop. What is the relative increase in surface energy?

solution.text:
Let the initial radius $r$ and finial radius $R . \frac{4}{3} \pi R^3=27 \times \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 \Rightarrow R=3 r$
$$
U_i=\left(S 4 \pi r^2\right) \times 27 \quad U_f=S 4 \pi 9 r^2
$$
Relative increacase $=\left(\frac{U_f-U_i}{U_i}\right)=\frac{9-27}{27}=-\frac{18}{27}=-\frac{2}{3}$
